title: Mexican Lamb Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Moroccan tagine, this Mexican lamb tagine combines the bold flavors of lamb with the spices and heat of Mexican cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, chili powder, coriander, and cayenne pepper (if using) to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb back to the pot, along with the xenial spice blend and Syrian allspice.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
Serve with warm flour tortillas and your favorite toppings.
Note: You can also make this recipe in a slow cooker. Brown the lamb and cook the onion and garlic in a skillet, then transfer everything to the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours.
